Install through Foundry

On the Foundry setup screen, open Add-on Modules → Install Module. Right-click the Foundry installation manifest link above and choose Copy link address, then paste it into Manifest URL and click Install. You can also copy the full URL below. Clicking the link opens the JSON file; Foundry needs its address.

https://github.com/Ugmul-dnd/ugmuls-5-5e-automation/releases/latest/download/module.json

The manifest link requires published release assets. Check GitHub Releases for currently available downloads and release assets.

Compatibility and integrations

Bonus-damage setup and compatibility. Automated damage riders such as Sneak Attack, Hex, and Hunter's Mark are based on the Foundry D&D 5.5e Player's Handbook items and activities. Automation may also work with characters imported from D&D Beyond, but those imports have not been tested.

Built for Foundry VTT v14 and D&D5e 6.0.5+, tested with 6.0.6. No additional module dependencies are required.

ModuleTested versionRecorded integration
Automated Conditions 5e14.606.2Sap/Vex roll defaults and advantage/disadvantage cancellation; Magic Resistance integration.
Dice So Nice!6.4.4Damage prompts and application wait for visible dice animations.

The October 12, 2026 test setup includes 47 companion modules. Being enabled in that world is not individual compatibility certification. Carousel Combat Tracker has a separately recorded error and needs further testing.

Starting spell list

Choose Add Starting Spell List in the manager. Six missing recipes are added disabled for review, preserving existing configurations. They contain activity names and settings—not spell text, activities, effects, or compendium content.

SpellStarting configuration
Hunger of HadarSeparate start-turn damage and end-turn save.
Spirit GuardiansEntry/turn-end saves, Once Per Turn, shared card.
GreaseEntry/turn-end save.
Spike GrowthMovement damage in five scene-unit increments.
Fog CloudEntry Use activity; vision requires separate setup.
Conjure AnimalsEntry/turn-end save, Once Per Turn.

Match each recipe to your own spell item, prepare any missing activities, check its timing, then enable and test a fresh cast. Region Effects are not preloaded.
